decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the well-established BASIC 518 trommel and is a core mobile screening product, so a withdrawal is unlikely despite the gap in website observations.
Mobile flail shredders fit the firm's mobile recycling core, though the missing website observations since 2020 add some uncertainty about the line's continuation.
The high-speed grinder line was only mentioned and not observed later, so it carries a higher risk of portfolio streamlining, but it still broadens the shredding offering.
The green-waste grinder serves composting and biomass customers but overlaps with Product C, making it a likely candidate if the firm consolidates its grinder lines.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders support the firm's plant-based and international strategy and had their own page, so they are likely retained.
